design.excerpt: This study aimed to investigate the effect of total dietary protein, animal-based protein, plant-based protein, and their substitutions with each other on the risk of BC using a pooled analysis of 10 cohort studies.

timing.excerpt: Individual data from 10 prospective cohorts containing 434,412 participants (overall male/female ratio was almost 3:1) with a total of 4,224,643.8 person-years of follow-up was analyzed.

continent.excerpt: including 10 prospective cohort studies from several European countries, the United Kingdom, and the United States.

ethnicity.excerpt: Finally, the majority of the current study’s participants were of Caucasian ethnicity

exposure_measurement.excerpt: Dietary intake data were obtained using validated semi-quantitative food frequency questionnaires (FFQs)
